summary: GeoPark Limited filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated October 15, 2026, covering its third-quarter 2026 operational update. Consolidated production averaged 27,973 boepd, up 2.6% sequentially, with Colombia stable and Argentina gross output rising 50.6% to 2,108 boepd after five Pad 1030 wells came online. The release also notes progress toward a Venezuela entry via the Bare Block, targeting closing by end-4Q2026, and positive Milano 1X and Toritos Norte 2 exploration results. This is a routine operational disclosure, not a special situation; no deal terms, board recommendation, or advisor were disclosed.
